data.name: Jambavati
data.gender_notes: Jambavati is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Patronymic from Jāmbavat, the bear king — Jāmbavatī. Its root is Sanskrit jāmbavat (जाम्बवत्). Jambavati, wife of Krishna. Jambavati is a Sanskrit name meaning “Of the Jambava (bear) king”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jambavati expresses “Of the Jambava (bear) king”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Patronymic from Jāmbavat, the bear king — Jāmbavatī.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jambavati total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
